selection: Two new configurations plus exactly reused control. Pooled inner correct count, macro-F1, declared order. Final choice uses cached inner predictions only.
features: Original AV128, MiniLM384 and fixed language16 from text rows with supplied Confidence >=0.8. No speaker attribution. Empty-filter fallback to original whole document. No questionnaire, scores, labels or IDs in inference features.
preprocessing: Fixed label-free filtering and frozen local MiniLM; train-only scaling/PCA32, fixed language block scale0.5, sqrt class weights fitted to real fitting supports. No resampling or calibration.
evaluation: Original163 participants, same5 outer/3 inner folds and seeds42/137/2026. No validation/test scoring. Long-history exploratory comparison.
motivation: 94 Mild and74 Moderate repeated errors in existing control;151 of their186 predictions go to majority. Some error cases lose8-19% words at fixed confidence0.8; low-confidence contamination is plausible, not proven. Similar-capacity model isolates the representation change.
stopping_rule: One new feature approach, two configurations, at most135 nested pipeline fits and2 full fits. No post-outer-result changes.
promotion_rule: Retain49.28 unless primary inner-selected procedure exceeds it on identical folds; call a positive paired interval only conditional exploratory evidence, never independent confirmation. Preserve every model.
